takeaway: Measured over two days, morluto/rea (+7,460 stars a day), ai-job-search (+2,226) and Cloudflare's security skill (+1,147) grew fastest. Yesterday's #2, the jailbreak plugin dsh-purge, has been deleted from GitHub.

findings.heading: Fastest measured growth, Oct 19 to Oct 21
findings.text: Between two of the radar's own readings: morluto/rea +7,460 stars a day, MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search +2,226, cloudflare/security-audit-skill +1,147, stablyai/orca +1,002, debpalash/VoiceStudio +986. 40 repos now have a measured delta.

findings.heading: The top jailbreak plugin is gone
findings.text: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge, ranked #2 yesterday with 18 watchers for 10k stars, now returns 404. The radar still ranks it on last week's signals; read it as delisted.

findings.heading: ai-job-search is accelerating without a news trigger
findings.text: Its gain rose from +1,559 stars a day to +2,226 a day. Its newest commits harden it against prompt injection in job postings. No launch or press was found.

findings.heading: morluto/rea's stated gains are still three times what the radar measures
findings.text: The trending page states +157,631 stars this week; the radar measured about 7,460 a day. It has 1.3k watchers for 350.8k stars. It stays flagged and discounted.

findings.heading: Generative UI is not uncrowded
findings.text: CopilotKit raised a $27M Series A for enterprise generative UI, and Thesys, Google (A2UI) and Vercel are all there. The open leaders are those companies' own funnels.

findings.heading: Unofficial clients face platform risk
findings.text: dsh-workbuddy-connect is shutting down on Oct 22 after WorkBuddy began restricting unofficial clients on Oct 20. The free-API gateway projects carry the same risk.

caveats: Every company figure today came from search-result summaries, because no news site could be opened from the cloud environment.
Hugging Face, Hacker News, the GitHub API and npm could not be reached for a third day.
Deleted or private repos keep ranking on their earlier signals until those age out of the 7-day window.
Some rule-generated hypotheses (agent memory, orchestration) repeat ideas the analysis has already disproved, because the commercial incumbents are not tracked.
No forecast has matured yet; the first scorecard is expected around 2026-10-27.
